name: Spherical-surface baseline preservation
purpose: Preserve a controlled analytic-sphere baseline before topography or later physical capabilities are enabled.
production_capability: Registered spherical internal boundary, linked AMR tree, compiled species/source configuration, and I11-qualified sampled observables.
configuration: Exact finest input derived with the I11 transformer: 60 km for approved m1_memory200.in, 5 km for explicit legacy FULL. Same-campaign I11 PASS required before launch; hash-identical to I11/<finest>km/application.in. Other CUSTOM/QUICK rejected. Frozen SPICE environment; neutral Na; impact vaporization enabled; MySource disabled.
independent_reference: Analytical 4*pi*R^2 for geometry and a reviewed regression baseline generated only after numerical/statistical qualification.
units: metres, square metres, seconds, particles per second, number density per cubic metre, column density per square metre, Rayleigh
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO with body-fixed controls in MOON_ME_DE421 at the receipt UTC converted by CSPICE to TDB ET.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Geometry is deterministic; sampled baseline seeds, independent blocks, MPI/OpenMP layout, and confidence intervals come from I11 artifacts.
procedure: Sum areas from every production sphere element; inventory and exactly compare the input hash, realized mesh counts, compiled species table, particle weights/time steps, and source totals; then compare reviewed I11 observables with the immutable archived CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Sphere area relative error <=1e-10; the reviewed deterministic configuration object matches exactly; every approved sampled metric remains within its predeclared I11 numerical plus statistical tolerance.
expected_pass_result: The corrected, numerically qualified sphere case is reproducible and can be paired with later LOLA runs.
required_data: campaign-generated reviewed I13 baseline; no observational data
data_hashes: SPICE and input hashes are captured in run_manifest.json; frozen science-CSV and configuration-JSON hashes are added to that manifest when the reviewed files are installed.
status_semantics: A geometry failure is FAIL. Missing I11-qualified metrics or either unreviewed/missing baseline artifact is SKIPPED. Infrastructure or corrupt reference evidence is ERROR. PASS requires exact configuration identity and the complete archived science comparison.
